title: Ground and Articulate the Procedural Beetle Gait
objective: Refine the existing TB-R03 gait so six two-segment legs visibly contact and push against the floor while restrained Body, thorax, and abdomen articulation conveys weight transfer without changing gameplay movement.
acceptance: each of the six stable leg roots contains mesh-bearing Upper and Lower segments whose transforms are captured from the authored neutral pose
neutral lower-leg geometry lies close to the local floor plane, improving on the measured TB-R03 minimum of approximately Y 0.0891 without deep clipping
all six Upper and Lower segments animate visibly, with swing endpoints lifted above support endpoints and opposing tripod phase preserved
leg sweep is clearer than TB-R03 while remaining attached, bounded, and stable across forward, strafe, backpedal, and diagonal movement
Body compression/bob and 1–3 degree-scale weight roll are restrained, Thorax articulates subtly, and Abdomen provides smaller opposing counter-motion
all articulated transforms blend smoothly from captured neutral poses and recover on idle without accumulation or snapping
CharacterBody root motion, collision, speed, controller, interaction, gameplay, beetle identity, and all prior slice behavior remain unchanged
TB-001 through TB-R03 regressions, grounded rendered evidence, Linux export, and exported runtime for all levels pass
no collision adjustment is made unless objectively necessary and no skeleton, IK, external asset, audio, or gameplay feature is introduced
